CREDIT MEMO / CASH-FLOW AND REPAYMENT SCHEDULE
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — not a real borrower or bank policy.
Applicant: Officina Aurora S.r.l.
Entity ID: DEMO-001
Scope: IT_SMALL_COMPANY_SECURED_TERM_EUR
Prepared: 2026-11-14
Currency: EUR; unit: individual euros

The business requests a secured term loan for production equipment. This demonstration uses a 2027 forecast and includes existing and proposed debt service.

Cash flow available for debt service [2027]: EUR 140,000.00
Existing principal due [2027]: EUR 40,000.00
Existing interest due [2027]: EUR 10,000.00
Proposed principal due [2027]: EUR 40,000.00
Proposed interest due [2027]: EUR 10,000.00

Cash available is the prepared forecast after operating costs, tax, maintenance investment and working-capital changes, before debt service. The assumption has not been independently verified.

FINANCIAL STATEMENTS / MANAGEMENT SUMMARY
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — not a real borrower or bank policy.
Applicant: Officina Aurora S.r.l.
Entity ID: DEMO-001
Scope: IT_SMALL_COMPANY_SECURED_TERM_EUR
Prepared: 2026-11-14
Currency: EUR; unit: individual euros

The following figures describe the specified entity on a standalone basis. The debt balance includes the proposed financing.

EBITDA [2026]: EUR 150,000.00
Post-loan interest-bearing debt [2026-12-31]: EUR 450,000.00

Historical context for comparison with ISTAT 2024, separate from the loan assessment:
Turnover [2024]: EUR 1,800,000.00
Value added [2024]: EUR 650,000.00
Labour cost [2024]: EUR 400,000.00
Persons employed [2024]: N 12
Employee count [2024]: N 10

These are synthetic management figures for demonstrating policy execution.

SECURITY / ACCEPTED COLLATERAL SCHEDULE
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — not a real borrower or bank policy.
Applicant: Officina Aurora S.r.l.
Entity ID: DEMO-001
Scope: IT_SMALL_COMPANY_SECURED_TERM_EUR
Prepared: 2026-11-14
Currency: EUR; unit: individual euros

For this fictional case, the assumed eligible collateral value is supplied after the illustrative valuation adjustments and prior claims. The software does not establish legal enforceability.

Secured exposure [2026-12-31]: EUR 200,000.00
Accepted eligible collateral value [2026-12-31]: EUR 300,000.00

Ownership, valuation, ranking and insurance require a bank reviewer.
